claims.claim: Falcon-180B trained on over 3.5T tokens, the largest openly documented pretraining run
claims.quote: The largest model, Falcon-180B, has been trained on over 3.5 trillion tokens of text–the largest openly documented pretraining run.

claims.claim: Falcon-180B nears PaLM-2-Large performance at reduced cost, one of the three best LMs
claims.quote: It nears the performance of PaLM-2-Large at a reduced pretraining and inference cost, making it, to our knowledge, one of the three best language models in the world

claims.claim: Custom distributed training codebase enabling efficient pretraining on up to 4,096 A100s on AWS with limited interconnect
claims.quote: we report on our custom distributed training codebase, allowing us to efficiently pretrain these models on up to 4,096 A100s on cloud AWS infrastructure with limited interconnect.

claims.claim: Open release of 600B token RefinedWeb extract and Falcon-7/40/180B models
claims.quote: We release a 600B tokens extract of our web dataset, as well as the Falcon-7/40/180B models under a permissive license

claims.claim: First publicly documented GPT-3-sized model following Chinchilla scaling recommendations
claims.quote: Falcon-180B is the first publicly documented GPT-3-sized model to follow the updated scaling law recommendations of Hoffmann et al. (2022),

claims.claim: RefinedWeb: 5T-token filtered and deduplicated web dataset, largest publicly documented
claims.quote: we developed RefinedWeb (Penedo et al., 2023), a 5 trillion tokens high-quality filtered and deduplicated web dataset–the largest publicly documented.

claims.claim: PaLM-based architecture with independently validated decisions resulting in minor tweaks (multigroup, no GLU, no biases, etc.)
claims.quote: The architecture of the models is based on PaLM (Chowdhery et al., 2022), although we independently validated each decision, ultimately resulting in some minor tweaks
claims.ablation_quote: In Table 11, training 1B models on 30B tokens of The Pile, we find no clear benefits from adopting SwiGLU for zero-shot performance

claims.claim: Extensive public documentation of pretraining of a large-scale model
claims.quote: At variance with these works, we extensively document the pretraining of the Falcon series.

seeds.quote: We independently quantified variance and average performance on over 50 tasks across 5 runs with a different seed (we use this σ for architecture experiments)
